name: @ionivetech/mugiwara
description: The Straw Hat crew of AI agents and skills: brainstorm, plan, execute, checkpoint, quality, gates, review, security, self-healing. Installs into Claude Code, opencode, Copilot, Gemini, Codex, Cursor, Kimi, pi, Windsurf, Cline, Kilo, Antigravity.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/mugiwara.js --target node --format esm
scripts.gate: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun scripts/validate-content.ts --check-manifest --check-docs && bun run verify-pack && bun scripts/run-evals.ts && bun scripts/retrieval-eval.ts
scripts.verify-pack: npm pack --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -q 'ionivetech-mugiwara' && echo '✓ npm package clean' || (echo '✗ npm pack failed' && exit 1)
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run sync-version
